videos.title: We're #1! 1993 North Carolina Tar Heels
videos.description: Players from the 1993 Men's Basketball North Carolina Tar Heels. Reflect on their great season.

videos.title: We're #1! - 1991 & 1992 Duke Blue Devils
videos.description: Through a mix of archival footage, photographs, game broadcasts and exclusive interviews, We're #1! looks back at the memorable Duke teams that defined an era of college basketball.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: Fresh off a victory, Syracuse (5-5, 3-5 ACC) takes on Boston College (4-6, 2-4) at Alumni Stadium in Chestnut Hill. Boston College seeks to snap a three-game skid after falling 41-7 to Notre Dame. Syracuse beat NC State 34-31 behind Steve Angeli.

videos.title: College Football
videos.description: The Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets (3-7, 2-5 ACC) host the No. 11 Wake Forest Demon Deacons (9-1, 6-1) in Atlanta. With only one loss this season, Wake Forest enters after beating SMU 49-7, while Georgia Tech beat Clemson 20-6 behind Alberto Mendoza.

videos.title: Live: ACC Huddle
videos.description: Host Taylor Tannebaum and analysts Jimbo Fisher, Eddie Royal and Eric Mac Lain go on the road to preview the slate of ACC football games.

videos.title: Live: College Football
videos.description: The Wolfpack (5-6, 3-5 ACC) face off against the Tar Heels (5-6, 2-5 ACC) at Kenan Stadium in Chapel Hill. NC State beat Florida State 28-10 to snap a two-game skid, while North Carolina seeks to end a two-game slide after a 41-24 loss to Virginia.

videos.description: Catch up with college football scores and highlights.

videos.description: The SMU Mustangs visit the Stanford Cardinal for an NCAA Division I FBS ACC conference game. The SMU Mustangs enter on a two-game skid with Kevin Jennings, while the Stanford Cardinal ride a two-game win streak alongside Davis Warren.
